notes: I changed the suffix rule: the box appends `'h'` only when the input contains no lowercase `'h'` (not based on whether the deduplicated result ends in `'h'`). This explains E6 (`"ha"→"ha"`, `"testh"→"tesh"`, `"hello h"→"helo "`) while still fitting E2–E5 where inputs lack a lowercase `'h'` and get one appended.
